source: Exact fresh complete lint diagnostics; only reported String calls/bare template expressions, all AST-classified before writes.
required: Full typed build; owner regressions over primitive conversions, opaque/cyclic objects and throwing coercion; invalid permissions/governance inputs must stay rejected; all suites. No rules weakened or source scope removed.

members.policy: Semantic text keeps all primitive conversions and original null/default evaluation; non-JSON objects/functions fail closed with fixed input-free TypeError. Diagnostic text retains primitive detail and replaces opaque objects/functions with fixed descriptors; never JSON-serializes unknown diagnostics.
